name: LLM Guard
what_it_does: Input and output scanner library for LLM applications. Bundles PII detection, prompt-injection heuristics, toxicity scoring, secrets detection, code-execution detection, and similar checks that can be composed into pipelines.
what_it_doesnt_do: It's a building-block library, not a turnkey policy engine. Some scanners are noisy; expect tuning. Performance overhead at scale needs design consideration.
best_for: Building input/output filtering pipelines for in-house LLM apps
Replacing ad-hoc regex scanning with composable, tested scanners
not_for: Use-cases where latency budgets are extremely tight without careful scanner selection
